meta.title: News From Tano | Tano
meta.description: Announcements from the Tano team, starting with our seed round led by Cherry Ventures.

items.title: Tano has raised $5m to make creators a true advertising channel.
items.body: We've raised a $4M seed led by Cherry Ventures, to make creators a performance advertising channel brands can buy like Meta or Google ads. Bringing our total funding to $5M thanks to earlier backing from Seedcamp and The Players Fund
